about_the_game:
Cards, machines, and engineers? Everything you need to build a factory is here!

Factory Planner is a card-based strategy/simulation game. By connecting cards together, you can extract resources, produce goods, and manage the efficiency of your factory.

For example: If you connect the input point of a "Miner" card to the output point of an "Iron Mine" card, the "Miner" will start extracting iron for you.

Similarly, if you connect the input point of a "Container" card to the output point of a "Miner" card, the iron extracted by the "Miner" will start being stored in the "Container."

Production Planning:

To use cards in the most efficient way, check the production panels and optimize your production planning.

Selling Cards:

You can earn Facredits by selling your cards. All the material cards you have discovered can be repurchased with the Facredits you earn.

Demo Features:

  • Resource, Extraction, Facility & Organization card categories

  • 100+ different cards

  • 1-2 hours of gameplay

Full Version Features:

  • Resource, Extraction, Facility, Organization, Engineer, Creatures, Plants & Exploration card categories

  • 500+ different cards

  • 16-20 hours of gameplay

short_description: Factory Planner is a card-based simulation/strategy game that lets you build a factory using cards. The main goal of the game is to make combinations with different cards so that each player can build different factories and feel the sandbox experience to the fullest.
